ideas.title: Custom Bestie Slot Unlock on Signup Decline
Beat Maker AI Synth Loop Sponsor

selected.why: Provides a classic paywall-decline fallback for price-sensitive non-payers dismissing the Luzia+ subscription sheet.
Capitalizes on explicit user intent to personalize a Custom Bestie right after they decline account creation.
Captures high moment-of-need intent when users tap the Deep Reasoning toggle in the attachment sheet during active conversation.
Establishes a proactive daily engagement habit on Chats Home, creating predictable rewarded ad inventory with zero chat interruption.
Monetizes high-value AI video rendering in the Anima mini-app at the exact point of export friction.

proposals.title: Paywall Decline Guest Services Pass
proposals.oneLiner: Offer a 15-minute trial of Luzia+ services via a rewarded mini-game after a user declines the account setup paywall.
proposals.trigger: User taps Maybe later on Create Account Sheet and returns to Services Tab without subscribing.
proposals.eligibility: Non-paying guest users without an account who have dismissed the Create Account Sheet paywall.

offer.title: Try Luzia+ Services Free
offer.body: Play a 15-second game to unlock Luzia+ services for the next 15 minutes.

proposals.cannibalizationGuard: Only surfaces after an explicit paywall decline as a guest-friendly fallback. To prevent subscriber substitution, the session is capped at 15 minutes once per day. To enable stateless bookings and alerts during the guest session, the backend maps temporary session tokens to secure device IDs, restricting high-risk operations (such as actual purchases) until a full account is linked. Crucially, requests during guest trials route to a lower-cost distilled model (text-cheap) to guarantee positive margins in low-eCPM regions.

kpis.primary: Luzia+ subscription conversion rate among paywall decliners over 28 days
guardrails: Overall D7 and D30 user retention non-inferiority margin within -1%
Total paid subscription revenue per user (non-inferiority margin -3% relative)
kpis.holdout: Randomized user-level 10% holdout group ineligible for rewarded guest fallback passes for 28 days

risks: Users with very low task needs may defer signing up indefinitely if their brief daily trial session is sufficient.
Premium task execution costs could still be high in low-eCPM areas if the distilled model fails to satisfy complex user prompts.

proposals.title: Custom Bestie Slot Unlock on Signup Decline
proposals.oneLiner: Offer guest users a single Custom Bestie creation slot after they dismiss the signup sheet.

offer.title: Create One Custom Bestie
offer.body: Play a 15-second mini-game to unlock one Custom Bestie slot without an account. Customize your AI companion immediately.

proposals.cannibalizationGuard: Surfaced strictly after the user declines the full signup sheet (m8), ensuring users with intent to sign up do so first [TAX-10]. Sized to a single creation slot, leaving multi-persona management, cloud backup, and Luzia+ features gated [CANN-1, AI-8].

kpis.primary: Custom Bestie creations by guest users
guardrails: Account signup conversion rate non-inferiority (-2% relative)
kpis.holdout: User-level 10% holdout of guest users declining Custom Bestie signup for 28 days

risks: Guest users might lose their custom bestie if local storage is cleared before creating an account.
Slight risk of delaying immediate account signup for users satisfied with a single custom persona.

proposals.title: Single Deep Reasoning Query Unlock
proposals.oneLiner: Unlock a single high-intelligence Deep Reasoning query by playing a quick partner mini-game.
proposals.trigger: When the user taps the disabled 'Deep reasoning' option (e15) on s27 while not subscribed to Luzia+.

offer.title: Try Deep Reasoning Free
offer.body: Play 2 quick 15-second games with Luzia to unlock 1 smarter, deeper answer.

proposals.cannibalizationGuard: The reward is strictly capped at 3 single-use queries per day, keeping the unlimited Deep Reasoning mode highly attractive under the main Luzia+ subscription. It also acts as a sampling mechanism to demonstrate the intelligence of premium answers. Paid conversion is protected by requiring a 2-ad bundle and gating to non-payers.

risks: Slightly increased LLM inference costs for reasoning models
Database engineering lift required to track and decrement individual query credits for non-payers

proposals.title: Daily Check-In Image Generation Hub
proposals.oneLiner: Introduce a daily check-in banner on Chats Home that rewards returning users with 1 AI Image Credit via a 3-ad bundle.

newMechanic.name: Daily AI Check-In
newMechanic.description: A daily check-in loop where users complete a 3-ad bundle to earn 1 AI Image Credit used in the Image Creation Hub.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: Bundling 3 ads ensures gross ad revenue covers the image generation API cost, making the reward sustainable.

proposals.trigger: User taps the Daily Check-In banner on Chats Home to open the check-in modal and initiates the claim.
proposals.eligibility: Non-paying, returning users in their 2nd or later active session who have not claimed today's check-in reward.

offer.title: Claim Your Daily Credit
offer.body: Play 3 quick games to unlock 1 free AI Image Credit.

proposals.cannibalizationGuard: Free credits are limited to 1 per day and require 3 ad completions. Unlimited generation and advanced styles require a Luzia+ subscription [CANN-2] [TRIG-4].

kpis.primary: D7 and D30 user retention rate
kpis.holdout: User-level 10% holdout group kept ineligible for the daily check-in feature for a duration of 28 days.

risks: Users might find a 3-ad bundle tedious, mitigated by a clear progress bar and engaging Simula mini-games.
Potential image generation API cost increases, mitigated by requiring 3 ad completions to fully fund the COGS.

proposals.title: Anima Queue Fast-Track Priority
proposals.oneLiner: Users can play a quick Simula game with Luzia to earn Fast-Track Credits that bypass the animation processing queue during peak hours.

newMechanic.name: Fast-Track Queue Priority
newMechanic.description: Introduce a fast-track rendering queue for Anima animations. Free generation remains unlimited but experiences wait times during peak processing periods, which can be bypassed using Fast-Track Credits.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: Protects user engagement by keeping free access intact while offering a zero-COGS progression utility that can be monetized via rewarded ads.

proposals.trigger: When the user selects an animation style like 'Clapping' (e24) or taps 'Animate' (e13) during periods where active rendering queue wait times exceed 10 seconds.
proposals.eligibility: Non-paying free tier users who want to skip the standard rendering queue during peak hours.

offer.title: Skip the Animation Queue
offer.body: Play a quick game to skip wait times and fast-track your animation.

proposals.cannibalizationGuard: Standard generation remains fully free and functional. Wait times only surface during authentic backend rendering congestion to prevent artificial friction, and Luzia+ subscribers always bypass processing queues.

kpis.holdout: User-level randomized holdout group, 10% allocation, evaluated over 28 days.

risks: If peak rendering queue wait times are negligible, the user's perceived value of Fast-Track Credits may diminish.
